components.name: Primary Project Button
components.description: Primary route into a project case study.
components.html: View Project
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:52px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:10px 18px; border:1px solid var(--ice); background:var(--ice); color:var(--bg-deep); font:700 .82rem Inter,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), box-shadow 260ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width:18px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.7; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.01); box-shadow:0 16px 36px oklch(0.72 0.14 244 / .28); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ice); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(-1px) scale(.985); }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: GitHub, live demo, and supporting actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; min-height:52px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:10px 18px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:oklch(0.72 0.14 244 / .035); color:var(--text); font:700 .82rem Inter,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:color 180ms ease,border-color 180ms ease,background 180ms ease,transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:var(--ice); background:oklch(0.72 0.14 244 / .08); color:var(--ice); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ice); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Metadata Badge

components.css: .ds-meta-badge { display:inline-flex; min-height:30px; align-items:center; padding:5px 10px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); font:700 .76rem ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace; letter-spacing:.08em; }

components.css: .ds-project-card { overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); box-shadow:0 24px 64px oklch(0.05 0.025 258 / .22); } .ds-project-media { aspect-ratio:16/9; background:var(--bg-deep); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); } .ds-project-copy { padding:24px; } .ds-project-copy span { color:var(--ice); font:700 .68rem ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:.12em; } .ds-project-copy h3 { margin:10px 0; font:700 1.35rem Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-project-copy p { color:var(--muted); }

components.name: Project Navigation
components.description: Centered Previous and Next controls without ambiguous numbering.
components.css: .ds-project-nav { display:inline-grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,auto); gap:10px; padding:8px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); background:var(--bg-deep); box-shadow:0 18px 46px oklch(0.04 0.025 258 / .34); } .ds-project-nav button { min-width:112px; min-height:48px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); font:700 .78rem Inter,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),color 180ms ease,border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-project-nav button:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color:var(--ice); color:var(--ice); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-project-nav button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ice); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-project-nav button:disabled { opacity:.28; cursor:default; }

narrative.overview: A focused technical workspace where project screenshots and clear actions carry the experience. Midnight surfaces preserve attention, while ice blue communicates priority and interaction.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight-blue layered surfaces with one clear ice-blue accent.
Large, compact headlines balanced by readable body copy.
Project screenshots carry more visual weight than decoration.
Square-edged controls and cards with thin structural borders.
Short motion that confirms interaction and never delays navigation.

rules.name: The Ice Signal Rule
rules.body: Ice blue must communicate priority or interaction. Never spread it across large decorative areas.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Never introduce pure black or pure white. Every neutral remains tied to the blue hue of the interface.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use sans for reading and hierarchy. Use monospace only for short technical labels and metadata.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal contrast first. Add shadow only when an element is raised, temporary, or interactive.

dos: Do show real project work before decoration.
Do keep navigation obvious and easy to use at every screen size.
Do use short, plain English descriptions.
Do keep the midnight-blue visual identity consistent.
Do separate quick project summaries from detailed project pages.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences and preserve keyboard focus states.
donts: Don't create crowded controls or duplicate navigation signals.
Don't hide navigation or make project movement depend on unexplained numbers.
Don't add decorative effects that reduce readability.
Don't use pure black, pure white, gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, bounce motion, or colored side stripes.
